stem:
A student makes a model of the sun-Earth system by swinging a ball around her head. Using this model, the student is trying to explain how Earth stays on a path around the sun.

The student explains that this path is the result of —

options.label: F
options.text: the magnetic attraction between Earth and the sun

options.label: G
options.text: potential energy stored in Earth that originated in the sun

options.label: H
options.text: the gravitational attraction between the sun and Earth

options.label: J
options.text: electromagnetic energy from the sun pulling on Earth

visual_elements: Model of Sun and Earth diagram showing a girl swinging a ball on a string with labels: 'Hand = Sun', 'Ball = Earth', and 'Path of ball'
